newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures close lower in thin volume.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures close lower in thin volume.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures settled slightly lower in the front months amid some spread, local and speculative dealings, traders said.
"We settled in the middle of the trading range," a trader said, referring to spot May which ended at 75.50 cents a lb, down 0.20 cent, with a session high of 76.20 and low of 75.10.
The rest of the board ended up 0.05 to down 0.10 cent.
Trading was choppy amid thin volume. "A lot of traders were attending the National Juice Products Association Convention in Arizona, so trading was thin," another trader said.
Estimated turnover was about 1,500 lots, almost unchanged from Thursday.
Resistance remained between 77.15 for May juice, with support pegged 72.00 cents, the trader said.
